ui.title: Supplier Disruption Impact Analyst
ui.tagline: When a supplier or site goes down, walks the supply graph to every part, product and customer order that depends on it, checks stock cover in parallel, quantifies days short and revenue at risk, and raises the mitigation a planner approves.

actions.label: Run: Supplier disruption impact
actions.description: A supplier or site disruption is reported. Kaman walks the supply graph to the products and customer orders that depend on it, checks stock cover in parallel, quantifies the impact, and - for critical impact - proposes a mitigation that a planner approves before any order is placed.

inputs.name: event
inputs.label: Event
inputs.default: Fire at the supplier's moulding line; output halted for an estimated 3 weeks

actions.label: Ask the Supply Graph Analyst
actions.description: Traces which items, products and open orders depend on a supplier.

inputs.name: question
inputs.label: Your question
inputs.default: Trace what depends on supplier SUP-0412 at Plant 3.
